title: Policies
intro: Relational risk-policy barriers persisted in the control plane and applied to the OpenPit engine per policy. Each row is one barrier for a target.

empty.noPoliciesHint: Add the first barrier to start constraining order flow.
empty.noMatchingHint: No barrier matches the current account or policy filter.

delete.title: Delete policy barrier?
delete.description: This removes the {{policy}} barrier on {{scope}}{{account}}{{asset}}. The engine is reconfigured immediately.

dialog.rateLimitFootnote: Both max orders and window are required.
dialog.atLeastOneFootnote: At least one value is required.
